verdict.rationale: Delegated, scoped third-party access is a fair question for an equity management platform, but the evidence pack never describes a way to give law firms, HRIS vendors or wealth managers limited access. There is no mention of roles, permissions, guest or advisor seats, scoped data-room sharing, or delegated API tokens. The Gusto integration is a single prebuilt data sync, not a general scoped-access model, and probes found no published API spec.
